suggestions.title: The Shawshank Redemption
suggestions.description: A banker convicted of murdering his wife and her lover engineers a meticulous escape from Shawshank prison over two decades, finding redemption through friendship and hope. Tim Robbins and Morgan Freeman deliver unforgettable performances in this timeless masterpiece.

suggestions.title: The Dark Knight
suggestions.description: Batman faces the Joker, a chaotic criminal who threatens to plunge Gotham into anarchy. Heath Ledger's iconic Oscar-winning performance as the Joker elevates this superhero film into a dark crime epic.

suggestions.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
suggestions.description: Three gunslingers compete to find a fortune in buried gold during the American Civil War. Sergio Leone's epic spaghetti western features Ennio Morricone's legendary score and Clint Eastwood's iconic Man with No Name.

shown_titles: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
